# Changelog

Every release's notes, newest first.

## Unreleased

- **A change not yet released.** Nothing to do yet.

## v1.10.0

Released 2026-11-20.

v1.10.0 renames a flag. These are the changes you can see:

- **`--old` is now `--new`.** Change your scripts. A tag in the notes, <script>alert(1)</script>, is shown as text.

### Security fixes

- **A path could escape its root.** Upgrade now.

## v1.9.0

Released 2026-11-01.

The first release in this fixture.

- **`oskac` exists.** See the [home page](/index.md).
